Booking intermediary and concierge. T&C: 'UNIQ operates an online platform for the brokerage of accommodations', acting as 'a booking intermediary'. LA CRÈME club, an email deals club: 'up to -30% off last-minute getaways', 'places that are normally booked out', 'offers not available anywhere else', 'Every second Wednesday, a curated drop of exclusive offers lands in your inbox'. monetization_evidence.evidence: The Terms & Conditions name the operator: 'GM Rocket Marketing GmbH, Holochergasse 49/33, 1150 Vienna, Austria'. They say 'UNIQ operates an online platform for the brokerage of accommodations' and acts as 'a booking intermediary, facilitating the conclusion of accommodation agreements between Customers and Hosts'. Guests pay a deposit of '30% of the total amount' within 5 business days, and a 'Rebooking fee: €20 per change' applies. No commission rate is published.

Priced rental listings in Austria, Italy and France, including CHALET CONSTANTIN (Italy) 'from 302€/night per person', WEIDEHAUS DELUXE (Austria) 'from 360€/entire chalet', LA BASTIDE DE FLÉCHON (France) 'from 3100€/entire villa'. Each has ENQUIRE/REQUEST buttons.
LA CRÈME club: last-minute deals by email ('up to -30% off'), capped at the 'first 15,000 members' for early access. This is an email list that feeds the booking platform. No fee is displayed.
